title: Move one object; light follows
creator: @higgsfield_ai
original_prompt_verbatim: Move the lamp to the right
why_interesting: Minimal instruction; tests whether spill light and shadows recompute without unrelated changes. Creator says previous models could not do this.

failure_notes: Source shows no result images (4 likes). @ZHO_ZHO_ZHO reports task loss after ~10 consecutive generations.
title: Master lock, then three narrow edits
creator: @godofprompt
original_prompt_verbatim: this image is the approved master. treat every visible attribute as locked unless I explicitly name it. for future edits, change only the requested variable and preserve everything else.
why_interesting: Maps directly to Depikt edit_source guidance. OpenAI docs warn repeated edits can still drift and recommend compositing for pixel-identical regions; test how many turns hold.

title: Wardrobe swap from image 2, identity fixed
creator: @godofprompt
original_prompt_verbatim: preserve identity, proportions, pose, camera, lighting and background. replace only [GARMENT] using image 2 as the reference. preserve its construction, materials, colors and details.
why_interesting: OpenAI's own prompting guide uses the same outfit example (image 1 identity, separate garment images).

title: Product into premium studio scene
creator: @godofprompt / Flixly
original_prompt_verbatim: treat image 1 as the immutable product reference. preserve exact geometry, materials, colors and branding. place it in [SCENE]. change only environment, lighting and camera composition.
why_interesting: Flixly's sample edit ('Change only the cream backdrop and tabletop to pale sage green. Keep the bottle's exact position, silhouette, blue finish...') is the follow-up edit to test in the same session.

title: Style reference + product into UGC frame
creator: @Mho_23
original_prompt_verbatim: Step 1 (Astra): Analyze this photo and give me a very detailed JSON prompt describing its visual style. Really make sure to break down the color grading, lighting and all the exact colors in the photo so I can apply that look to my own images. Step 2: Using this JSON as reference, generate a person holding my product.
why_interesting: Two-step: extract art direction as JSON first, then generate. Depikt's Builder can produce the step-1 description itself.

title: Four-image merge by role
creator: @godofprompt
original_prompt_verbatim: image 1 = identity. image 2 = clothing. image 3 = environment. image 4 = composition. use each image only for its assigned role. combine them into one coherent photorealistic scene.
why_interesting: Matches OpenAI guidance to identify each input by number and purpose. Depikt currently takes one reference image; this is the case for multi-image intent.

title: UI from functional-spec screenshot + donors
creator: 12ui (r/codex u/withmagi)
engagement: r/codex thread; 12 prompts, 3 models, 5 quality levels
original_prompt_verbatim: Treat Image 1 as a functional specification, not a design reference: preserve only its interaction archetype, information needs, and useful actions. Create a new original, aesthetically exceptional, polished, and usable interface for [PRODUCT] ... Find a coherent, aesthetically resolved intersection between the distinct visual-system logics in Images 2 and 3. Transfer their reasoning rather than combining their literal motifs, content, or layouts. Create fresh copy and entirely new visual assets; do not reuse pixels, logos, brands, proper nouns, readable phrases, illustrations, photos, icons, or a recognizable arrangement from any reference. Use the full native-ratio canvas without padding, cropping, stretching, letterboxing, a device mockup, or a surrounding frame. Return only the finished interface design.
why_interesting: Measured: Flare medium $0.0437 / 18.7 s vs GPT Image 2 medium $0.0739 / 50.7 s; Sunburst max $0.1923 / 80.6 s. Commenters: numbering references works; 2.5 layouts have more breathing room; warm tint fixed.

title: Reformat UI to new aspect without cropping
creator: @godofprompt
original_prompt_verbatim: recompose this exact image for [ASPECT RATIO]. do not simply crop it. preserve the subject and visual hierarchy while intelligently extending and rearranging the scene.
why_interesting: 2.5 accepts arbitrary WIDTHxHEIGHT (divisible by 16, 1:3 to 3:1), so the adaptation can state exact pixels.

failure_notes: Vendor account (Banana Prompts app), 1 like; prompt lives in a reply.
title: Outfit photo to ink + watercolor illustration
creator: @bananaprompts
original_prompt_verbatim: Fashion illustration of a person wearing [color] [outfit], full-body pose, confident expression, hand-drawn ink lines with loose watercolor and paint splashes, bold brush textures, white background, elegant editorial fashion sketch, clean composition, stylish magazine
why_interesting: Generic style prompt; the 2.5-specific question is whether the outfit's construction survives the medium change when a photo is attached.

title: Mid-century Japanese railway poster with exact title
creator: @Goodmanprotocol
original_prompt_verbatim: [1,733-character template; opens] Create a premium, ultra-refined Showa-era Japanese vintage travel poster for [LOCATION]. FORMAT: Vertical 3:4 | Collector's travel poster | Mid-century Japanese railway tourism aesthetic ... palette deep navy blue, warm ivory/aged paper, muted mustard yellow, vermilion red ... flat printed color fields, paper grain, ink misregistration ... reserve negative space at the bottom for typography. Main title: ...
why_interesting: Well-structured long template (FORMAT / CORE CONCEPT / VISUAL STYLE / COLOR & PRINT TEXTURE / TYPOGRAPHY & LAYOUT). Do not copy; write Depikt's own with quoted title text and a no-extra-text rule.

failure_notes: Author states 2.5 models returned model_not_found on their key; prompts were NOT run on Images 2.5.
title: Cladding-only change on a photographed building
creator: MeltFlex (Matúš Koleják)
original_prompt_verbatim: This is a photo of an existing building. Keep the building outline, the window openings, the roof line and the camera exactly as they are, and change only the cladding to vertical charred-effect timber with bronze window frames.
why_interesting: Clean CHANGE ONLY / PRESERVE structure.

failure_notes: Sneaker sketch-only returned nothing after 90 s.
title: Sketch + brief into poster, sketch-alone control
creator: Kingy AI (Curtis Pyke) / @Synthetic_Copy
original_prompt_verbatim: Turn this rough sketch into a polished finished image. Preserve the composition and every object. Add no text.
why_interesting: Self-scored: sketch+brief 97.8 vs sketch alone 64.6. Sketch is a layout constraint, not a style reference; Depikt's sketch_layout intent already says this. @Synthetic_Copy's 'change the composition to this' (2 images) is the edit-mode variant.

title: Product cutout on true transparent background
creator: @godofprompt / OpenAI docs
original_prompt_verbatim: preserve the product exactly. remove the environment and isolate it on [BACKGROUND/TRANSPARENT]. repair only edge details required for a clean catalog image. do not alter color, branding or proportions.
why_interesting: OpenAI: request background="transparent", PNG or WebP, check alpha at hair, glass, shadows, edges. In ChatGPT the prompt must ask for a transparent PNG explicitly.

title: 4x4 sprite sheet on transparent, retest after failure
creator: @8co28 / @Mayz1169
original_prompt_verbatim: (8co28 published no prompt; follow-up instruction, translated: 'after making the background transparent, split it 4x4, align, and make a GIF'). Mayz1169 published a full 16-frame idle-animation spec: 4 columns x 4 rows, 1024x1024 canvas, 256x256 cells, 16 px transparent padding, RGBA alpha zero, no checkerboard.
why_interesting: Second most-liked post in the index reports transparency FAILED on the first pass and needed a new chat. Mayz1169's spec is the structured version to adapt.

title: Nine chained edits on one character
creator: @ctgptlb
original_prompt_verbatim: 星を拾う→持ち上げる→元に戻す (Pick up the star, raise it, then return it to its original position)
why_interesting: Feed each result into the next edit; compare frame 1 to frame 9 for face, texture, background. Ran on Flare.
